description: Data-plane read access to a Key Vault's secrets (Get/List) - harvest stored credentials, connection strings, and keys.
prerequisite_privilege: Key Vault Secrets User/Reader (RBAC) or a Get/List secret access policy
abuse_primitive: az keyvault secret list/show against the vault to dump stored secrets.

telemetry.detail: Key Vault data-plane logging (SecretGet/SecretList) is NOT default-on - it requires a diagnostic setting to a Log Analytics workspace/storage. Without it, secret reads leave no trace.
Defender for Cloud (Key Vault plan) can alert on anomalous/high-volume secret access; paid plan + diagnostic logging.

notes: Quiet by default: Key Vault data-plane auditing is opt-in, so unless diagnostic settings are enabled the read is invisible - a genuine blind spot.
